title: Minimal no-op-gate verification declaration (positive fixture)
description: Positive fixture: a conforming verification declaration that declares zero verification checks. Declaring no content does not open the gate: the gate positions remain and the gates remain — a no-op gate, not an open door (§4.4; lifecycle-model.md §5.1). The complete gate set (G1–G6 + emptyDeclarationKeepsGate) and evidence requirement set (E1–E5) are affirmed as the contract floor, the checks array is empty, and both position bindings (Verify stage, verify phase) declare empty check lists.
